tickets.title: Python SyntaxError: Unterminated String & Unclosed Parenthesis
tickets.problem_summary: Python script in "test_visualize.py" contains an invalid print statement: "print(What does the Visualize button do". The string text is missing quotation marks and the opening parenthesis '(' is never closed.

detected_errors.error_code: SyntaxError: invalid syntax / '(' was never closed
detected_errors.description: Line: "print(What does the Visualize button do" -> Text inside print() is unquoted, and closing parenthesis ')' is missing.

tickets.possible_root_cause: In Python, text literals passed to print() must be enclosed in single ('...') or double ("...") quotation marks. Without quotes, Python attempts to parse the words as language syntax identifiers or variable names, triggering a SyntaxError. Furthermore, every opened parenthesis '(' must have a matching closing parenthesis ')'.
tickets.user_resolution:
1. Enclose the text inside quotation marks: "What does the Visualize button do".
2. Add the closing parenthesis ')' at the end of the line.
3. Replace the line with the corrected code:
   print("What does the Visualize button do")
tickets.technical_resolution:
# Corrected code in test_visualize.py:
print("What does the Visualize button do")

# Validate syntax in terminal:
python -c 'print("What does the Visualize button do")'

tickets.title: Python Script Execution & Traceback Exception Analysis
tickets.problem_summary: Python script failed during evaluation or runtime execution. Diagnosed from source code structure, traceback logs, and user problem statement.

detected_errors.description: Exception triggered during script execution or module compilation.

tickets.possible_root_cause: Mismatched indentation, undefined variable/module, unhandled exception, or type conflict in function arguments.
tickets.user_resolution:
1. Open the file and inspect the exact line cited in the error traceback.
2. Ensure indentation uses 4 spaces consistently throughout the file (no tabs).
3. Install any missing dependencies in your environment using pip install <package_name>.
tickets.technical_resolution:
1. Compile-check syntax without executing: `python -m py_compile script.py`
2. Run automated static analysis: `ruff check script.py` or `pylint script.py`
3. Ensure virtual environment isolation: `python -m venv .venv && .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 && pip install -r requirements.txt`

tickets.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Saturation & Gateway 503 Outage
tickets.problem_summary: Elevated connection concurrency exhausted PostgreSQL max_connections capacity, causing upstream API gateways to reject customer transactions with HTTP 503 and acquire timeout exceptions.

detected_errors.error_code: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
detected_errors.description: All client connection slots occupied by lingering idle transactions.
Visual checkout banner displaying payment gateway connection refusal.

tickets.possible_root_cause: Direct microservice connections without a connection pooler (PgBouncer); connection leak in backend job.
tickets.user_resolution:
1. Please wait 2-3 minutes while server connections are recycled.
2. Refresh the browser and retry checkout.
3. The backend team has expanded connection bandwidth.
tickets.technical_resolution:
1. Scale PgBouncer pool_size and transaction pooling:
   max_client_conn = 1000
   default_pool_size = 50
2. Kill idle connections:
   SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle in transaction' AND state_change < now() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';
3. Set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '30s' in postgresql.conf.

tickets.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Saturation & Backend 503 Outage
tickets.problem_summary: Application backend experienced repeated 503 Service Unavailable drops due to PostgreSQL pool exhaustion. Correlated server logs at 14:22 UTC with Grafana spike and client-side error dialog.

detected_errors.error_code: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
detected_errors.description: Max connections limit (100) reached, blocking incoming microservice queries.
Payment gateway checkout timed out during database acquire phase.

tickets.possible_root_cause: Node.js connection pool size set to default 10 without PgBouncer multiplexing; background cron job spawned 40 concurrent workers holding idle transactions.

evidence_correlations.connection_details: Log timestamp 14:22:18 corresponds exactly to the 503 response timestamp on the checkout UI

tickets.user_resolution:
1. Refresh browser after 2 minutes.
2. Clear local browser session storage.
3. The engineering team has scaled connection capacity and stabilized the checkout service.
tickets.technical_resolution:
1. Adjust postgresql.conf max_connections = 300
2. Deploy PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode:
   pool_mode = transaction
   default_pool_size = 50
   reserve_pool_size = 10
3. Set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 30000

tickets.title: Windows Kernel BSOD 0x0000003B Graphic Subsystem Crash
tickets.problem_summary: Workstation encountered sudden blue screen (SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION) during high-load render task. Minidump correlates with audio voice description of fan throttling.

detected_errors.description: Kernel memory fault initiated in nvlddmkm.sys driver code offset 0x43a210.
User reported high pitch acoustic noise immediately preceding screen freeze.

tickets.possible_root_cause: Outdated NVIDIA Studio Driver 551.23 interacting with Windows 11 24H2 memory integrity virtualization (VBS).

evidence_correlations.connection_details: Acoustic report matches the kernel dump timestamp within a 3-second window

tickets.user_resolution:
1. Boot workstation into Safe Mode by holding Shift while restarting.
2. Download latest certified GPU driver package.
3. Run clean installation wizard and reboot normally.
tickets.technical_resolution:
1. Execute DDU (Display Driver Uninstaller) in Safe Mode with /clean /restart flags.
2. Set Windows Registry TdrDelay:
   [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers]
   "TdrDelay"=dword:00000008
3. Install clean WHQL driver v572.16 without GeForce Experience telemetries.
